stories.headline: RSF drones kill four near Khartoum and hit a UN building
body: Drone attacks blamed on Sudan's RSF killed four people around Khartoum.
They damaged a UN building, government buildings and the airport.
stories.vc: Attacks on aid sites make humanitarian work harder.

stories.headline: Netanyahu and Eisenkot end coalition talks without a deal
body: Talks between Netanyahu's Likud and Eisenkot's Yashar on a unity government ended without agreement.
They are split on who leads and whether Itamar Ben-Gvir joins.
They met in a Herzliya hotel on Sunday.
stories.vc: Political uncertainty weighs on Israel's markets.

stories.headline: Nepal PM Balendra Shah arrives in Delhi for his first official visit
body: Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah arrived in New Delhi on Sunday.
He will open several projects and hold talks with PM Modi on Monday.
Officials say the talks will set direction for ties in coming years.
stories.vc: Closer ties could unlock hydropower and trade deals.

stories.headline: India and China hold talks to ease Arunachal border tensions
body: India and China held a second round of Corps Commander-level talks on the LAC in Arunachal Pradesh.
They aim to prevent friction between troops before harsh winter.
stories.joke: Talking beats shouting, especially at altitude.
stories.vc: Calmer borders support trade and investment ties.

stories.headline: Tasmac goes digital-only for liquor buys above ₹1,000 in Chennai
body: Tasmac liquor shops in parts of Chennai will take only digital payments for purchases above ₹1,000 from November 23.
Cash stays an option for smaller buys.
The rule starts in Chennai and Tiruvallur East.
stories.vc: Digital payments improve tracking of the state's liquor revenue.
